# Marilla Cuthbert & Rachel Lynde

- [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) — Friend of — [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) — longstanding friendship despite their differences · since v1  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P12](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P45](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0045), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P83](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0083), +4 more</sub>

## Shared scenes

> Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) spots [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) driving off in his best clothes, which piques her curiosity. She visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to investigate, where [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) reveals that [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) has gone to [Bright River](../codex/places.md#bright-river) to fetch an orphan boy they are adopting to help on the farm. Mrs. Rachel voices strong disapproval and concern over the risks of taking in a stranger child before departing to spread the news.
>

> Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and insults Anne's looks, prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to fly into a furious rage and yell at her. After an offended Mrs. Rachel departs, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) confronts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in her bedroom and orders her to stay in her room until she agrees to apologize.
>

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) secretly visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in her room and persuades her to apologize to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) so she can come out of isolation. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) agrees and delivers a dramatic, melodramatic apology that completely appeases Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md). On the walk home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) expresses her joy at having a real home, touching Marilla's heart.
>

> After being publicly humiliated and forced to sit with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) refuses to return to school. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) consults [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who advises letting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stay home until she calms down. Later, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is overcome with laughter when she finds [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) weeping hysterically over the imaginary future scenario of [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) getting married.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) invites [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) over for afternoon tea while [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is away, but mistakenly serves her three glasses of homemade currant wine instead of raspberry cordial. [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) becomes sick and dizzy and has to go home, leading Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) to forbid [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) from playing with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) ever again.
>

> While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. Rachel attend a political rally in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) stay at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) rushes in seeking help for [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md), who has severe croup while her parents are away. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) uses her past experience with children to treat [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md), saving her life, which leads Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) to forgive [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and allow her and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to be best friends once again.
>

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) convinces [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to let [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attend the [Debating Club](../codex/factions.md#debating-club) concert and spend the night with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md). After enjoying the concert, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) race into the spare-room bed at Diana's house, accidentally leaping onto visiting [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md), who reacts furiously.
>

> After discussing her latest blunder with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) to apologize directly to [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) for jumping onto her bed. Her honest confession and imaginative explanations charm Miss [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) into staying in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and continuing Diana's music lessons.
>

> During a game of dares at Diana's party, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attempts to walk the ridgepole of Mr. Barry's roof and falls, breaking her ankle. Mr. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) carries her home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), making [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) realize how deeply she loves the girl. During her seven weeks of recovery, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives many visitors and eagerly anticipates returning to school under her new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md).
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to school in October and thrives under her new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md). She enthusiastically talks to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) about her schoolwork and field trips, though [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) remains critical. Later, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) proposes organizing a Christmas concert to raise money for a school flag, which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) embraces wholeheartedly despite Marilla's skepticism and Matthew's encouraging support.
>

> Noticing how plain Anne's clothes are compared to other girls', [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) tries to buy her a trendy puffed-sleeve dress at a [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody) shop, but gets so intimidated by the clerk that he ends up buying rakes, seed, and sugar instead. He enlists Mrs. Lynde's help to buy and sew the fashionable brown dress, which he presents to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) on a snowy Christmas morning alongside a pair of slippers from [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is overjoyed by the gifts and goes on to star in the successful [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Christmas concert.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) secretly regrets her ongoing feud with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), though the two remain intense academic rivals. Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) confirms she will return to teach next year, relieved students pack away their studies, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) resolves to enjoy her summer before growing up. Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), expressing her relief over Matthew's health and admitting to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) how remarkably well [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has matured.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) completes her [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) and returns to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) to anxiously await the results. [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) brings news that the pass list is out and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has tied for first place on the Island with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares her joyful success with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), concluding the evening with a peaceful visit to Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md).
>

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) collapses and dies suddenly after reading news of the bank failure. The household and community mourn his death, and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) express their deep love for each other in their shared grief. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) talks with Mrs. [Allan](../character/allan.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about coping with sorrow and moving forward.
>

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) learns from an oculist that her eyesight is failing, prompting her to consider selling [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) refuses to let the home be sold, revealing her decision to forgo her college scholarship and remain in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) to teach and care for [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) later informs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) gave up the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school position for her, leading [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to reconcile with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and become close friends with him.
>

> Anne's peaceful afternoon reading [Virgil](../codex/tech.md#virgil) is interrupted by her angry neighbor, Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), who confronts her after her cow strays into his oats field. Later, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns home and discusses the incident and family matters with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), after which Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) arrives and shares local gossip about incoming residents.
>

> Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discuss Stephen Irving's son coming to stay in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). The conversation shifts to Anne's plans to form a Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), which Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) cautions against, and the news that Anne's friend [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) will be teaching at [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody).
>

> On the eve of beginning their teaching jobs, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) debate whether corporal punishment is ever necessary in school. Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) speaks with Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), who also scoffs at her ideal of governing pupils purely through affection. The next morning, a anxious [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) drinks ginger tea prepared by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) before setting off to school.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) begins her first day teaching at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school, observing her new pupils and feeling a special connection with [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md). After school, an eccentric parent, Mrs. Donnell, confronts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about how her children's names are pronounced and used. Returning home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares her experience with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), remaining determined to win over the sullen [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md).
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), the Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), and the hall painting project with Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) before leaving for home. Shortly after [Joshua Pye](../character/joshua-pye.md) finishes painting the hall, Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) discovers it has been painted bright blue instead of green due to a mix-up with the paint numbers. [The Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers) are initially devastated, but the rest of [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) rallies in sympathy and support for them against the [Pyes](../codex/factions.md#pyes).
>

> In a detailed letter to her friend [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) describes her experiences and humorous anecdotes from teaching her pupils. She shares various amusing classroom incidents and transcripts of letters written by her students, concluding with a imaginative composition by her favorite pupil, [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md).
>

> Suffering from a toothache and a frustrating day, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) mistakenly orders a pupil to throw a package into the school stove, causing an explosion of firecrackers. Later, when [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md) plays a prank on her with a mouse, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) loses her temper and whips him. Though distraught over her loss of self-control, she discovers the next morning that the punishment earned Anthony's respect.
>
> — v2 · XII A Jonah Day

_Sources: [v2 XII A Jonah Day P18](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0018), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P19](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0019), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P50](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0050)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) converses with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) about Marilla's improving eyesight and the upcoming [Aid Society](../codex/factions.md#aid-society) bazaar, then returns home to learn that [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md) will remain with them through the fall. She recalls disciplining [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) for eating forbidden jam, after which she attends an Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) meeting where [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md) alerts everyone to Judson Parker's plan to rent his fence for advertisements. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) attempt to talk Judson out of it, but he refuses to change his mind.
>
> — v2 · XIV A Danger Averted

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P4](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0004), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P15](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0015), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P35](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0035), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P50](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0050)_

> Before [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) leaves for town with [Dora](../character/dora.md), she and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) talk with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) about behaving well. Left alone to do chores, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally dyes her nose red with rug dye instead of applying freckle lotion, right as [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) unexpectedly arrives with Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) and Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md). [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) helps [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) save the day by bringing chicken for dinner, and the guests enjoy a delightful meal and a walk through the woods before departing.
>
> — v2 · XX The Way It Often Happens

_Sources: [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P1](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0001), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P36](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0036), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P43](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0043)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovers that Mr. Harrison's wife, [Emily](../character/emily.md), has unexpectedly arrived in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) to reunite with him. The news quickly spreads through the neighborhood and school, leading Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) to step in and assist [Emily](../character/emily.md). Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) at his newly cleaned home, where he prepares to explain the backstory of his marriage.
>
> — v2 · XXV An Avonlea Scandal

_Sources: [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P16](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0016), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P28](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0028), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P43](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0043), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P55](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0055)_

> Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) explains to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) how he and his wife [Emily](../character/emily.md) originally separated over domestic habits and his parrot [Ginger](../character/ginger.md) before reconciling. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stays to eat tea with the Harrisons, walks back across the fields with [Emily](../character/emily.md), and later puts [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) to bed at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) while conversing with [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).
>
> — v2 · XXV An Avonlea Scandal

_Sources: [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P56](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0056), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P59](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0059), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P60](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0060), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P71](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0071)_

> Following [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md) Lynde's death, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) proposes that [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) move into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) so [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) can leave to attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) resigns from her teaching position, which causes great sorrow among her students and her friend [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), even as she prepares for her new journey.
>
> — v2 · XXVI Around the Bend

_Sources: [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P26](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0026), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P34](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0034)_

> As preparations for Miss Lavendar's wedding get underway, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses the romantic turn of events with [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), Charlotta the Fourth, and a skeptical [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally discovers that [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) are in love, leading [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to visit [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to confide her engagement details to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).
>
